name: Hibernal-Pediment
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by an orbital debris ring, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Nothing about the temporal distortion zone appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
